newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sanluis Q1 net falls to 128 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Sanluis Q1 net falls to 128 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexican mining and autoparts company Sanluis Corporacion said Tuesday its net profit was 128 million pesos for the 1997 first quarter, down seven percent from a year earlier.
The company said in a report that earnings for the quarter were 1.61 pesos per CPO share.
"The smaller profit growth and operating margins with respect to sales in the first quarter of 1997 are the sole result of a drop in gold and silver prices," the company said.

Sanluis said its operating margin for the first three months of the year was 21 percent, compared with 26 percent during the year ago period. Net sales in the first quarter of 1997 were $65 million, for a 27 percent increase from the previous year. In constant pesos, sales reached 517 million pesos, up six percent from the same period in 1996.
Sanluis exports about 90 percent of its volume, and about 51 percent of its costs are in pesos, the company said.
